stories.title: Meta 发布两款新模型，宣称可与业界最强模型正面竞争
stories.sourceTitle: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
stories.summary: 在推出重组后 Superintelligence Labs 的首个模型 Muse Spark 和 AI 智能体 Muse 之后，Meta 又发布了两款新模型，并称其能力可对标行业顶尖水平。这是 Meta 在 AI 竞赛中加快追赶节奏的最新动作。
stories.analysis: Meta 正试图用密集发版证明自己没有被甩出第一梯队，但真正的考验是这些模型能否在开发者与企业场景中留住用户。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta is making up for lost time in the AI race. After launching Muse Spark, the first model from its revamped Superintelligence Labs division, and buzzy AI agent Muse, it's now launching two new models it claims can go toe-to-toe with the industry's best. The

stories.title: 微软发布第三代自研 AI 芯片 Maia 300，定位自家产品的主力推理系统
stories.sourceTitle: Microsoft’s new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia’s GPUs
stories.summary: 微软发布第三代自研 AI 芯片 Maia 300，目标是成为微软产品和服务的“主要 AI 推理系统”，以降低云端运行 AI 工作负载的成本并提升效率。此举意在减少对 Nvidia GPU 的依赖。
stories.analysis: 自研推理芯片是云厂商锁定成本结构的关键一步，但推理端的替代比训练端更容易见效，也更容易被生态兼容性拖慢。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Microsoft is announcing its third-generation Maia in-house AI chip today, designed to be the "primary AI inference system" for Microsoft's products and services. Maia 300 not only improves the cost and efficiency of running AI workloads in the cloud, it's also

stories.title: Meta 发布首个前沿模型 Muse Wonder，主打复杂任务与编码能力
stories.sourceTitle: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
stories.summary: 相比定位低延迟轻量级的 Muse Spark，Muse Wonder 体量更大、能力更强，在基准测试和编码等复杂任务上成绩更好。这是 Meta 首次推出前沿级别的模型。
stories.analysis: 把轻量模型和前沿模型拆成两条线，说明 Meta 在同时争夺端侧响应速度和高端能力两个战场。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.

stories.title: 气象气球加 AI 预测天气，WindBorne 拿下美国空军近 5000 万美元合同
stories.sourceTitle: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data
stories.summary: 这家硅谷创业公司用气象气球配合 AI 进行天气预测，赢得了价值近 5000 万美元的美国军方合同。
stories.analysis: 气象预测是 AI 少有的、能直接对接国防预算的垂直场景，数据采集硬件反而成了护城河。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A Silicon Valley startup that uses weather balloons and AI to predict the weather won a U.S. military contract worth almost $50 million.

stories.title: 微软总裁 Brad Smith 呼吁紧急监管 AI，称英国最适合主导规则制定
stories.sourceTitle: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
stories.summary: 微软总裁 Brad Smith 呼吁尽快对 AI 立法监管，并称牛奶和洗衣机受到的监管都比 AI 公司更多，认为英国在推动 AI 监管方面处于最有利位置。
stories.analysis: 科技公司高管主动喊监管，通常意味着希望规则由熟悉的司法辖区先写，而不是等更严厉的版本落地。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.

stories.title: Honeyjar 推出 AI 工具，想改造企业的公关与传播流程
stories.sourceTitle: Honeyjar offers AI tools to improve PR and comms at every company
stories.summary: Honeyjar 面向各类公司提供 AI 公关与传播工具。原文指出，记者、创业者甚至部分公关从业者都认为现有的 PR 流程已经失灵，问题在于 AI 是否真能让它变好。
stories.analysis: 公关是典型的信息不对称生意，AI 能压缩写稿和分发成本，但媒体关系那部分未必能被自动化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Journalists, entrepreneurs, and even some public relations professionals will tell you that the PR process is broken. But could AI actually make things better?

stories.title: Blueprints AI 称可从照片或草图在几分钟内生成符合规范的施工蓝图
stories.sourceTitle: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes
stories.summary: 位于圣塔莫尼卡的 bootstrap 创业公司 Blueprints AI 开发了软件，能从照片、PDF 或草图生成符合建筑规范的施工蓝图。
stories.analysis: 把“符合当地法规”做成模型能力，比单纯生成图纸更难被复制，也更容易形成行业数据壁垒。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Blueprints AI, a bootstrapped startup based in Santa Monica, developed software that produces code-compliant construction blueprints from a photo, PDF, or sketch.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 明日开幕，门票优惠进入最后 24 小时
stories.sourceTitle: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 starts tomorrow: Your final chance to secure up to $100 ticket savings
stories.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 将于太平洋时间明天上午 8 点在旧金山 Moscone West 开幕，超过 1 万名创始人、投资人和科技从业者将参加为期三天的活动，门票最高 100 美元的优惠进入最后阶段。
stories.analysis: 这类大会的看点不在议程，而在于下一批融资和产品发布往往在这里完成预热。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tomorrow at 8 a.m. PT, it all begins z— 10,000+ founders, investors, and tech operators will gather at San Francisco’s Moscone West for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 for three days of ideas, connections, and startups shaping what comes next. This is your last 24 hou

stories.title: 前 Plaud 高管为“后台持续聆听”的 AI 应用融资 2600 万美元
stories.sourceTitle: Former Plaud exec raises $26M for AI app that listens to you in the background
stories.summary: 一位前 Plaud 高管为新的 AI 应用筹集 2600 万美元，该应用在后台持续聆听用户。原文指出，AI 的核心承诺之一是了解用户越多、辅助越准，而这通常需要应用和设备持续收听、观看或记录。
stories.analysis: 常驻聆听类产品能否成立，取决于隐私叙事能否说服用户，而不取决于模型能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: One of the core promises of AI is that the more it knows about a person, the better it will be able to assist them with tasks and make appropriate suggestions, which, if you'll believe the tech companies, requires apps and devices to listen, watch, or record u

stories.title: 硅谷开始跟随特朗普把 AI 改称“超级智能”的提法
stories.sourceTitle: Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump’s attempt to rename AI
stories.summary: 特朗普提出把 artificial intelligence 重新命名为“super intelligence”，起初外界普遍认为这不会流行，但报道称硅谷一些有影响力的人物已开始跟随这一说法，尽管大众仍习惯用 AI。
stories.analysis: 术语之争看似表面，实际是谁来定义技术叙事的权力之争。
stories.sourceExcerpt: When President Donald Trump announced his plans to rebrand artificial intelligence as "super intelligence," you'd be forgiven for being skeptical that it would catch on. While most of the broader population is sticking with AI, some of Silicon Valley's most po

stories.title: 一位用户尝试日常使用本地 AI：兴奋、不知所措又令人沮丧
stories.sourceTitle: Learning to use local AI is exciting, overwhelming, and frustrating
stories.summary: The Verge 作者开始尝试在本地运行强大模型，而不把最私密的数据交给云服务。原文称这一过程既令人兴奋也令人不知所措和沮丧。
stories.analysis: 本地模型的门槛正在从“能不能跑”转向“值不值得折腾”，这正是消费级硬件厂商的机会窗口。
stories.sourceExcerpt: I'm embarking on a journey I've so far been hesitant to go on: actually using AI on the regular. Giving my most personal data to cloud services has been a major hold up for me, but it's increasingly possible to run powerful models locally to see what they're c

stories.title: 纳德拉：我们应当假设所有 AI 模型都已被“攻陷”
stories.sourceTitle: Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are ‘compromised’
stories.summary: 微软 CEO 萨提亚·纳德拉在 X 上发表长文，阐述高度先进 AI 模型带来的风险。他表示不能再接受把 AI 当作“嵌套黑箱”的世界，其建议和行动无法被追责。
stories.analysis: 把“所有模型都已被攻陷”作为默认前提，实际上是在为更强的平台级安全与审计层铺路。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In a lengthy post on X, Microsoft's CEO laid out his views on the dangers posed by highly advanced AI models and how to confront those risks. Nadella says we can no longer accept a world where AI is treated as a "set of nested black boxes" whose advice and act

stories.title: Anthropic：重要 AI 动态
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic’s AI gave Philadelphia police a fake tip about an unsolved homicide
stories.summary: The Verge 报道关注「Anthropic：重要 AI 动态」。它可能影响行业主线、公司竞争和后续产品节奏。英文原题保留在卡片下方，方便回到原文核对细节。
stories.analysis: 这类消息通常会影响 AI 行业的主线判断，适合放在今日重点里追踪后续变化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: An Anthropic AI model provided false information about an unsolved homicide to a Philadelphia Police Department (PPD) tipline, according to a report from 6abc. In a statement released on Friday, the PPD said the AI model sent the tip through PhillyUnsolvedMurd

stories.title: 数学家评 OpenAI 最新数学成果：“纯粹疯狂”，消化需要数年
stories.sourceTitle: ‘Pure insanity’: Mathematicians will need years to make sense of OpenAI’s latest drop
stories.summary: The Verge 采访了 30 多位数学家，他们对 OpenAI 发布的大量数学结果使用了“惊人”“压倒性”“前所未有”“超现实”“纯粹疯狂”等描述，并认为理解这些结果需要数年时间。
stories.analysis: 当结果多到领域专家无法在短期内验证，AI 在数学上的贡献就从“工具”变成了新的验证瓶颈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: "Staggering." "Overwhelming." "Unprecedented." "Surreal." "Pure insanity." Those were among the descriptions more than three dozen mathematicians reached for in conversations with The Verge as they tried to make sense of the flood of mathematical results OpenA

stories.title: Sophos 用 OpenAI Daybreak 把威胁调查时间缩短 96%，自动化 52% 的 MDR 案件
stories.sourceTitle: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
stories.summary: Sophos 借助 OpenAI 的 Daybreak 将网络威胁调查时间缩短 96%，并自动化了 52% 的 MDR 案件，同时保留人工监督。
stories.analysis: 安全运营是 AI 代理最容易被量化收益的场景，因为每一个被节省的分钟都能直接换算成人力成本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.

stories.title: Pollo AI 借助 GPT-5.6、GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-Image-2.5 把创意变成广告素材
stories.sourceTitle: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
stories.summary: Pollo AI 使用 GPT-5.6、GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-Image-2.5，帮助创作者把创意转化为精细图像和电影感的视频广告。
stories.analysis: 营销素材生成正在成为多模型组合的试验场，考的不是单点能力而是流水线的稳定性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

stories.title: LegalOn 把 Codex 日常成本砍掉 65%，开发速度保持不变
stories.sourceTitle: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
stories.summary: LegalOn 将 Codex 的估算日常成本削减了 65%，同时保持开发速度。做法是把 Astra、Sol 和 Luna 按任务类型分配，并对预算进行策略性管理。
stories.analysis: 多模型路由已经从技术优化变成财务纪律，企业开始按任务复杂度而不是按习惯选模型。
stories.sourceExcerpt: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.

stories.title: OpenAI 封禁两起 AI 驱动的“假面”影响力行动
stories.sourceTitle: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
stories.summary: OpenAI 阻止了两起由 AI 支持的影响力行动，这些行动使用伪装成记者的账号和一个智库来传播地缘政治信息。
stories.analysis: 生成式 AI 让影响力行动的成本降到接近零，平台方的披露和封禁节奏将直接影响舆论场的可信度。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging.

stories.title: ChatGPT for Teens 上线大学申请规划工具，并成立青少年 AI 委员会
stories.sourceTitle: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 将 College Planner 引入 ChatGPT for Teens，帮助学生管理大学申请，同时推出新的记忆卡片、测验功能以及一个青少年 AI 委员会。
stories.analysis: 把青少年作为独立用户群运营，既是产品线扩张，也是在监管压力下主动塑造“负责任”形象。
stories.sourceExcerpt: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

stories.title: OpenAI 公开内部前沿模型在数学开放问题上的新结果
stories.sourceTitle: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
stories.summary: OpenAI 发布了内部前沿模型在数学开放问题上的新结果，并在 GitHub 上公开了 Lean 证明形式化过程和研究细节。
stories.analysis: 公开 Lean 形式化证明，是把“AI 做数学”从新闻稿变成可验证成果的关键一步。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

stories.title: OpenAI 与 Ironclad 合作，训练 AI 代理处理复杂合同工作流
stories.sourceTitle: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
stories.summary: OpenAI 与 Ironclad 正在复杂合同工作流上训练和评估 AI 代理，以推进电脑操作能力在专业工作中的应用。
stories.analysis: 合同是 computer use 的理想切入口：流程长、规则明确、出错代价高，正好检验代理的可靠性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

stories.title: Atlassian 与 OpenAI 扩大合作，把企业知识接入前沿模型
stories.sourceTitle: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
stories.summary: Atlassian 和 OpenAI 扩大合作，将前沿模型与企业知识连接起来，帮助团队规划、构建和交付工作。
stories.analysis: 企业知识是模型落地的最后一公里，谁掌握了 Jira、Confluence 这类工作流入口，谁就掌握了上下文。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

stories.title: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 中推出新视觉广告形式并扩展归因工具
stories.sourceTitle: Building advertising for the way people use AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 中引入新的视觉广告格式，同时扩展了广告主的测量工具、归因合作和品牌适配能力。
stories.analysis: 广告是 ChatGPT 从订阅制走向规模化营收最现实的路径，但也是最容易损害用户信任的一步。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

stories.title: Chatham Financial 用 Codex 和 GPT-5.6 把交易验证从 30 分钟压到 4 分钟以内
stories.sourceTitle: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
stories.summary: Chatham Financial 使用 Codex 和 GPT-5.6 构建技术并重新设计工作流，把交易验证时间从 30 分钟缩短到 4 分钟以内。
stories.analysis: 金融后台流程的自动化收益清晰可见，但真正的门槛在于合规审计能否跟上新的处理速度。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.

stories.title: OpenAI 发文：突破性想法背后的日常执行工作，才是 AI 最大的价值所在
stories.sourceTitle: The eternal complement
stories.summary: OpenAI 发布文章《The eternal complement》，提出先进 AI 最重要的作用可能在于突破性想法背后的常规工作，并探讨执行环节如何影响下一阶段的经济与进步速度。
stories.analysis: 这是一种叙事铺垫：把 AI 定位为执行层的补充，而不是取代创意阶层，能显著降低社会抵触。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.

stories.title: AI 智能体三周重构 30 万行代码，Code Health 从 5.6 升至 10.0
stories.sourceTitle: AI 智能体三周重构 30 万行代码，Code Health 从 5.6 升至 10.0：代码真的变好了吗？
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文报道了一起 AI 智能体在约三周内重构 30 万行代码的案例，代码健康度指标从 5.6 提升到 10.0，并追问代码是否真的变得更好。
stories.analysis: 重构指标好看不代表可维护性提升，这类案例的价值在于暴露了“AI 重构后谁来 review”的问题。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: 通义千问发布 Qwen3Guard，为 token 流提供实时安全防护
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen3Guard 是 Qwen 系列首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 基础模型针对安全分类任务微调，可对 token 流进行实时安全判断。
stories.analysis: 把安全判断做到 token 级别，意味着内容审核从“事后过滤”转向“边生成边拦截”，对部署方更实用。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tech Report GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope DISCORD Introduction We are excited to introduce Qwen3Guard, the first safety guardrail model in the Qwen family. Built upon the powerful Qwen3 foundation models and fine-tuned specifically for safety classificatoin,

stories.title: 通义千问发布 Qwen-Image-Edit，主打更高质量与效率的图像编辑
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen-Image-Edit: Image Editing with Higher Quality and Efficiency
stories.summary: Qwen-Image-Edit 是 Qwen-Image 的图像编辑版本，基于 20B 的 Qwen-Image 模型构建，并延续了 Qwen-Image 在文字渲染方面的能力。
stories.analysis: 图像编辑的竞争焦点正从“能不能改”转向“改完文字还对不对”，中文渲染能力是国产模型的差异化优势。
stories.sourceExcerpt: QWEN CHAT GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DISCORD We are excited to introduce Qwen-Image-Edit, the image editing version of Qwen-Image. Built upon our 20B Qwen-Image model, Qwen-Image-Edit successfully extends Qwen-Image’s unique text rendering capabiliti
